text: In 2021, Facebook deleted itself from the internet. By accident.
say: In twenty twenty-one, Facebook deleted itself from the internet. By accident.

text: October 4. Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp all went dark at once.
say: October fourth. Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp all went dark at once.

text: The cause? One command during routine maintenance.
It was meant to check their network. Instead, it cut every link between their data centres.
To open an app or website, your phone first asks the internet's phone book where it lives.
Facebook's phone book went silent. So to every phone on Earth, Facebook simply didn't exist.
Even staff got stuck. Reports said some couldn't get into buildings with their badges.
Engineers had to go to the data centres in person to get it running again.
About 6 hours later, it all came back.
say: About six hours later, it all came back.

text: But for those 6 hours, businesses that only lived on Instagram couldn't be found at all.
say: But for those six hours, businesses that only lived on Instagram couldn't be found at all.

text: The lesson? Social media is rented land. Your website is land you own.
If Instagram went down tomorrow, could customers still find you? Follow for more Internet Stories.
